doc: hunter-regen-1120: kael_emit/master.glb is the a6 master plus an emission map of the vein lines on his red arms (job 060044-a1, gens/hunter-regen-1120/a1d/kael_emit.py: lines brighter than the local red glow orange, as on the turnaround). a new Meshy generation from the owner-picked turnaround (meshy-7.1 multi-image, quad remesh 60k), joints/head/anchors from Meshy's auto-rig (v95_joints.py). Before: v95 swap spec (docs/art/wardens/V95_SWAP.md): LIVE 11-13 (ext/showcase-1113): current.json tilt1112/cand_A, the 11-12 black+red colour grade on the appeal3 body and face (its own sword left out: kael_tilt_A_body.glb). Earlier: Kael's v95 master, appeal3 body variant c with the owner-approved appeal3 face (~/meshy/v95/Kael/r2/appeal3/cand_c.glb, its own sword left out: kael_v95_c_body.glb), onto kael.glb's (juggernaut's) skeleton, clips and anchors. kael.glb's own skinned sword (its materials, on hand.R) stays. Points in the fit frame (his front +Y, his right +X, soles on z 0, the master's metres), read on tools/art1/v95_grid.py's renders. The shawl rides the hips and its shoulder flaps the pauldrons; the master's wrist chains ride the hands. The master's curse (veins, emission map) is on his LEFT arm, as in the v2 turnaround, so the arm blooms move to the left arm.
